acceptanceCriteria: corvint-tasks doctor lists each active attempt whose branch is missing base shared-path commits older than a threshold, naming the ticket and oldest commit.
A claim result includes a notice when the claimed base is missing shared-path commits present on main.
Both are read-only and covered by tests.
body: Residual from V1-1710 (PR #1097, GitHub #1092). `corvint changes behind --format doctor-plugin` emits SHARED_BASE_BEHIND for one branch, but nothing discovers live ticket worktrees and runs it, and a claim result never mentions shared-path commits the branch lacks. Expected: corvint-tasks doctor (or dispatch) enumerates active attempts/worktrees and flags stale ones; claim reports missing shared commits at claim time.
title: corvint-tasks doctor/claim: detect live ticket worktrees missing base shared-path commits (built-in, not only the doctor-plugin output)
